Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the angles around the upper side of \(O\) form a straight angle, totaling \(180^\circ\).

Let the central angle of the shaded sector be \(\theta\). The other labeled angles in the upper half sum to

40^\circ+35^\circ+30^\circ+20^\circ=125^\circ.

Thus,
\[
\theta=180^\circ-125^\circ=55^\circ.
\]

For a uniformly random point in the disk, the probability is the ratio of the sector’s area to the disk’s area:
\[
\frac{\text{sector area}}{\text{disk area}}
=\frac{55^\circ}{360^\circ}
=\frac{55}{360}
=\frac{11}{72}.
\]
